title: Score hit its stated maximum (366/366) with four entire holds (Hollowbrook, Saltkerns, Emberfall, the Fallows) and a companion's whole personal arc (Vell's Exile's Ledger) still untouched, so the counter stopped giving any signal about how much story-relevant content remained versus purely optional side content.
